name: Ousuki Konome
source:
The yamato nadeshiko heroine, classmate of [url=/c468]Saku[/url]. Her grace and intellect can be felt just from her speech, always using words at it’s primitive meaning. Though usually calm and mild, she gets into fights with [url=/c465]Futami[/url] (often with Futami not even realizing it). Also possess a secret with Saku, perhaps the reason as to why she panics around him? ;)

[From [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/01/24/itsuka-todoku-ano-sora-ni-review/]Warum's review[/url].]
